column1: # Does the CNF threshold change the STP-vs-Bitwuzla verdict?
# The corpus comparison at the 5s cap was run with STP at its stock CNF effort.
# Threshold 0 is worth ~19% of STP's solver time on top of that, so the margin
# over Bitwuzla should widen -- but the two results come from different sweeps,
# and a cross-sweep ratio is not a measurement. This runs all three in one
# interleaved sweep so the comparison is like-for-like.
# stp-medium reproduces the old stp-tuned configuration on the new build, and
# is the bridge back to the cap5 numbers.
# label <TAB> backend <TAB> LD_LIBRARY_PATH for libstp (or -) <TAB> extra klee args
